newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: INP wins favourable ruling on exchangeable shares.
newsitem.headline: INP wins favourable ruling on exchangeable shares.

text.p: Independent Press Communications on Tuesday said it won a favourable Inland Revenue Department ruling in New Zealand on the tax treatment of dividends from exchangeable preference shares being offered to Wilson & Horton shareholders.

Independent Press, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Independent Newspapers Plc (INP), on Monday upped its bid for W&H to NZ$11.00 per share from $10.50 and as an alternative to cash is offering 1.375 INP shares for each W&H share.

"The ruling provides confirmation, for those who accept the offer of exchangeable shares, that the dividends from these shares can carry full imputation credits for New Zealand tax purposes," INP said.
